title: [master]-Bug 647093-[Subscription Billing] Incorrect Invoice Amounts when using explicit values in Subscription Line End Date
summary: Subscription billing now calculates correct invoice amounts and billing periods when using explicit end dates with daily or weekly billing rhythms and month-end alignment, by skipping month-end alignment for fixed-length day and week formulas.
key_points: Fixed incorrect billing period boundaries and amounts for non-usage-based subscription lines with daily/weekly rhythms and month-end alignment
Root cause was CalculateNextToDate() incorrectly applying month-end alignment to fixed-length day/week formulas
Solution skips end-of-month alignment for day and week formulas while preserving it for month/quarter/year rhythms
Correction applied at the source in CalculateNextToDate() eliminates billing boundary and proration errors
Added test coverage for period calculation scenarios
quote: Incorrect Invoice Amounts when using explicit values in Subscription Line End Date
